components.name: InfoBar
components.description: An inline message bar with a severity, a title and a message, optionally closable: Windows 11's InfoBar colored by its severity, GNOME's AdwBanner (banners have no severity), or on macOS, which has no message bar, a grouped form section with a colored SF Symbol (inferred). The severity is a toast's Type: "success", "warning", "error" or informational.

components.name: InfoBarActions
components.description: An InfoBar with action buttons where the platform puts a message bar's action: Windows 11's InfoBar ActionButton, after the message or below it in a narrow bar; on macOS buttons at the end of the bar before the close button, centered on the title's line; GNOME's AdwBanner button, which takes the place of its Dismiss button. The buttons are drawn over the bar's fill.

components.name: ProgressRing
components.description: A circular progress indicator filled to a value from 0 to 1: macOS's determinate spinning NSProgressIndicator, Windows 11's ProgressRing with IsIndeterminate false, or on GNOME, which has none, a ring after AdwSpinner in the accent (inferred). A negative value shows the Spinner.

components.name: StatusPage
components.description: An empty-state page with an icon, a title, a description and actions below them: GNOME's AdwStatusPage, SwiftUI's ContentUnavailableView on macOS, or on Windows 11, which has no such control, a page after WinUI's type ramp (inferred).
